negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'štatistika platobného styku' (payment statistics) dataset section exists on the current nbs.sk site. The Payments section (https://nbs.sk/en/payments/) lists only TARGET services, SIPS, SEPA instruments and payment cards — with no statistics subsection — and the Statistics portal root (https://nbs.sk/statisticke-udaje/) likewise has no payment-statistics branch.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetched both the Payments section and the Statistics portal root; neither exposes a card/ATM/POS statistics dataset page. The legacy path www.nbs.sk/sk/statisticke-udaje/platobny-styk returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's headline topics (card counts, POS/ATM terminal counts, card transaction volumes) are compiled by NBS but appear to be disseminated primarily via the ECB payments statistics datasets rather than as standalone NBS downloads. A collector that only crawls nbs.sk will systematically miss these series.

negative_findings.description: No SDMX or documented REST API for NBS's own statistical series was found. OpenStats and the Makroekonomická databáza are interactive JS front ends with download buttons; the only documented contact points are statdata@nbs.sk and makroekonomickadatabaza@nbs.sk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in both languages for an NBS SDMX/web-service endpoint; results returned only OpenStats, the macroeconomic database, and third-party SDMX docs (Bundesbank, ECB) — no NBS API documentation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Long-term automated collection from NBS will likely require endpoint reverse-engineering or headless-browser export rather than a stable API contract, raising fragility and maintenance cost. The ECB Data Portal API is the stable alternative for NBS-reported payment series.

negative_findings.description: Several candidate URLs were taken from search-result links rather than successful fetches (časové rady vybraných ukazovateľov, financial sector analytical data, supervisory disclosure statistical data, SDDS Plus data categories). They are recorded as hypotheses.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs captured from search engine results; not independently fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must confirm these before they are promoted; a 403/timeout on nbs.sk should not be read as dead.

negative_findings.description: NBS has migrated from the www.nbs.sk legacy structure to the current nbs.sk information architecture. Some legacy statistics paths now 404 while the legacy /_img/documents/ file store still serves historical PDFs, and some pages (e.g. TARGET statistics) exist on both trees.
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed a 404 on www.nbs.sk/sk/statisticke-udaje/platobny-styk while www.nbs.sk/_img/documents/... PDFs remain reachable via search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: URL stability cannot be assumed for a multi-year collector; link-tree diffing and Wayback fallback should be built in from the start.

negative_findings.description: No NBS statistical dataset on cash circulation (hotovostný peňažný obeh — banknotes and coins in circulation, cash withdrawal volumes) was located. Slovak-language search returned only the Banknotes and Coins information section and a commentary article ('Hotovosť neumiera'), not a data page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched 'štatistika hotovostného peňažného obehu bankovky a mince'; hits were explainer and coin-production pages under nbs.sk/bankovky-a-mince, no time-series dataset.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cash usage is an explicit run topic; if NBS does not publish it nationally, ECB banknote/PSD series and the cash-withdrawal side of the card statistics become the substitute path and must be sourced elsewhere.

coverage_gaps.description: The authoritative Slovak card / POS terminal / ATM counts and transaction series were not located as a downloadable NBS product; they appear only via ECB payments statistics datasets and via SBA-published card statistics (outside this cell).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull SK series directly from the ECB Data Portal PSD/PCP datasets via API, and open a separate coverage cell for the Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) monthly card issuing/acquiring statistics, which are compiled from NBS/member-bank reporting.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unknown whether OpenStats and the Makroekonomická databáza expose stable JSON/CSV endpoints behind their dashboards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-based network-trace pass on both tools to capture the underlying data endpoints and document them; if none are stable, contact statdata@nbs.sk about bulk/API access.

coverage_gaps.description: Pre-redesign historical payment-system statistics (annual report chapter 'Platobný styk', pre-2009 SKK-era tables) are only reachable as scattered legacy PDFs with no index.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate www.nbs.sk via the Wayback Machine CDX API to build a complete historical inventory before more legacy paths decay.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact NBS reporting templates (výkazy/hlásenia) that define which card and terminal fields banks must report were not opened in this pass; the ŠZP submission layer is credentialed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the public methodological information and code-list files under 'Informácie pre vykazujúce subjekty' to reconstruct the reported field set without touching the authenticated portal.

coverage_gaps.description: Some NBS statistical subpages (notably SIPS statistics for 2009-2013) exist only in Slovak, while the /en/ tree is otherwise near-parity.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Always crawl the sk tree as the canonical source and treat /en/ as a supplementary mapping layer, not a substitute.

brief: Národná banka Slovenska is unambiguously the legally mandated compiler of Slovak monetary, banking and payment statistics, but its public statistics estate is split across three distinct surfaces: the modern nbs.sk/statisticke-udaje portal (MFI balance sheets, time series, interest rates, macroeconomic database, OpenStats dashboards, SDDS Plus, methodology and code lists), the Payments section (SIPS and TARGET payment-system transaction statistics, plus explainer pages on cards), and a decaying legacy www.nbs.sk file store holding pre-redesign historical payment-system tables. Critically, no standalone NBS dataset for card counts, POS/ATM terminal counts or card transaction volumes was found on nbs.sk — those NBS-compiled series are disseminated in machine-readable form through the ECB Data Portal payments statistics datasets (PSD/PCP/PAY, reference area SK), which should therefore be treated as the primary retrieval channel for this cell's headline topics. No NBS SDMX or documented API was found, so collection from NBS itself will rely on scheduled file harvesting driven by the published data release calendar, with headless-browser or endpoint reverse-engineering for the interactive OpenStats and macroeconomic-database tools.
